text.p: The communications sector at Lyonnaise des Eaux remains modest but has made gains since last year, the group's chairman Jerome Monod said on Thursday.

"Communication does not yet have a very large turnover with 1.6 billion francs in sales. But this activity is profitable and the value it creates is already considerable for its shareholders," Monod told a news conference.
The sector's profits were 44 million francs in 1996.

For Lyonnaise Cable, which currently has 420,000 subscribers, the breakeven point will be reached only this year. The cable unit had sales of 900 million francs, an increase of 15 percent over 1995, but losses were 20 million francs.
Lyonnaise des Eaux was counting on the arrival of digital cable to revitalise this activity, he said.
"Not only does Lyonnaise Cable plan to distribute all digital programmes but it will also soon propose Internet access as well as local loop telephone on most of its cable systems," Monod said.
